actionCalls.description: Synchronously invokes the platform's processGiftCommitment standard action on the just-created GC after the N Yearly N=1 GCSs land via Create_GCS_Custom. Activates the schedules — populates GC.CurrentGiftCmtScheduleId, NextTransactionDate, NextTransactionAmount — and fans out Expected GTs for future-dated rows. Past-dated rows are skipped by the fanout engine; Loop_GT_CustomBuild hand-authors compensating GTs downstream when Decide_GCS_Custom_PastDate_Needs_GT fires. Fault shares Err_Create.
actionCalls.name: Process_Custom_Commitment
actionCalls.label: Activate Custom Commitment

actionCalls.description: Synchronously invokes processGiftCommitment on the just-created Recurring GC after Create_GCS_Recurring lands the single open-ended GCS. Activates the schedule so GC.CurrentGiftCmtScheduleId, NextTransactionAmount, and NextTransactionDate populate immediately instead of waiting for the daily FQS_Coordinate_Gift_Commitment_Processing batch. Fault shares Err_Create.
actionCalls.name: Process_Recurring_Commitment
actionCalls.label: Activate Recurring Commitment

actionCalls.description: Synchronously invokes processGiftCommitment on the just-created Scheduled GC after Create_GCS_Scheduled lands the parent GCS. Activates the schedule (populates GC.CurrentGiftCmtScheduleId, NextTransactionDate, NextTransactionAmount) and fans out the first Expected GT. Without this the record waits for the once-daily FQS_Coordinate_Gift_Commitment_Processing batch at 01:00 UTC. Fault routes to Err_Create — if the org has no default GiftDesignation the action returns INVALID_API_INPUT ("The org wide default designation is not yet configured..."), surfaced via the shared error screen; see [[fqs-orgwide-default-designation]].
actionCalls.name: Process_Scheduled_Commitment
actionCalls.label: Activate Scheduled Commitment

actionCalls.description: Synchronously invokes processGiftCommitment on the just-created Simple GC after the Yearly N=1 GCS lands via Create_GCS_Simple. Activates the schedule, populates GC.CurrentGiftCmtScheduleId + NextTransactionDate + NextTransactionAmount, and fans out the single Expected GT for future-dated pledges. For past-dated pledges the platform activates the schedule but does not fan out — Decide_GT_Simple_PastDate_Needs_GT then routes to a hand-authored compensating GT. Fault shares Err_Create.
actionCalls.name: Process_Simple_Commitment
actionCalls.label: Activate Simple Commitment

assignments.description: Stages rsv_GDSC for insert on the parent GC. ParentRecordId is polymorphic (Campaign / GC / Opportunity, NOT Account, per [[gdd-parent-polymorphic]] which applies identically to GDSC). Role comes from PickGDSC_pk_Role; PartialPercent is optional — null means the platform propagates the recipient across every GT as a full soft credit, non-null means fractional recognition. Connects to Create_GDSC.
assignments.name: Assign_GDSC_Base
assignments.label: G. Default Soft Credit — Base

assignments.description: Inside Loop_GDSC_FanoutToGSC. Builds one GiftSoftCredit per GDSC on the parent GC, mirroring RecipientId / Role / PartialPercent from rsv_GDSC_LoopItem and pointing GiftTransactionId at the just-created rsv_GT.Id. Appends to col_GSC_FromGDSCs for bulk-insert on loop drain and increments var_GSC_FanoutCount so Screen_Success can render a summary line.
assignments.name: Assign_GSC_From_GDSC
assignments.label: G. Soft Credit — From GDSC (loop body)

assignments.description: Builds a self-recognition GiftSoftCredit for the In-Kind gift. RecipientId is the donor Account (recordId); PartialAmount is FMV from rsv_GT.FQS_Fair_Market_Value_Amount__c (SoftCreditAmount is platform-derived from PartialAmount on insert and is not writable). Role 'In-Kind Recognition' keeps this pattern distinguishable from third-party soft credits. Fires for every In-Kind gift with a positive FMV regardless of the user's SinglePayment_pk_NeedsSoftCredits choice — the manual soft-credit picker recognizes a related Account for a cash gift; this element recognizes the donor themselves for the non-cash value.
assignments.name: Assign_GSC_InKind_SelfCredit
assignments.label: G. Soft Credit — In-Kind Self-Credit

assignments.description: Body of Loop_GDD_ResolverCampaign_FanoutGTD. For each Campaign-side GDD in rsv_GDD_SplitLoopItem, builds a fresh GTD in rsv_GTD_SplitScratch (GiftTransactionId, GiftDesignationId, Percent from AllocatedPercentage, Amount from formulaSplitGTDAmount) and appends to col_GTD_Split. Separated from Assign_GTD_Split_FromGC because each Flow Assign has a single connector target and the loop-back differs.
assignments.name: Assign_GTD_Split_FromCampaign
assignments.label: GT Designation — Split (Campaign loop body)

assignments.description: Body of Loop_GDD_ResolverGC_FanoutGTD. Mirrors Assign_GTD_Split_FromCampaign field-for-field against the GC-side GDD source; connects back to Loop_GDD_ResolverGC_FanoutGTD instead of the Campaign loop.
assignments.name: Assign_GTD_Split_FromGC
assignments.label: GT Designation — Split (GC loop body)

assignments.name: Assign_GC_Campaign_Prefill
assignments.label: G. Commitment — Prefill Campaign from GC

assignments.description: On the Pledge Payment inherited-Campaign path, populates rsv_Camp_Selected from Get_Camp_ForGC so the Campaign+Designation resolver can consult the parent GC's Campaign default. If the GC has no Campaign, Get_Camp_ForGC returned zero rows and rsv_Camp_Selected remains null; the downstream .Id IsNull gate on Decide_GT_Campaign then skips the GT.CampaignId write. Connects to Assign_Resolver_Inputs.
assignments.name: Assign_GC_Campaign_UseAsSelected
assignments.label: G. Commitment — Use GC's Campaign as Selected

assignments.description: Body of Loop_GT_ConfirmPaid on the past-payments confirmation branch. Flips rsv_GT_ConfirmedLoopItem.Status to 'Paid' and appends the row onto col_GT_ConfirmedPaid for bulk update by Update_GT_ConfirmedPaid on loop drain. TransactionDate is deliberately untouched — the money cleared on its original due date, so this path is a status flip only, not a fresh entry.
assignments.name: Assign_GT_Confirm_Paid_Row
assignments.label: G. Transaction — Mark Confirmed Row as Paid

assignments.description: GC-context entry stager. Runs only when the flow is invoked as a subflow from FQS_Guided_Gift_Entry_GiftCommitment (contextCommitmentId is set). Writes recordId with rsv_GC_Selected.DonorId so the downstream Account-prep chain (Get_Acct → Get_Contacts_ForAcct → Get_CampaignMember_ForAcct → Get_Camp_ForAcctMemberships) runs against the donor's Account. rsv_GC_Selected is already populated by Get_GC_Context via outputReference, so no SObject-copy happens here — that pattern silently drops field values on downstream reads (see [[flow-sobject-assign-drops-fields]]). Connects to Get_Acct.
assignments.name: Assign_GC_Context_Entry
assignments.label: G. Commitment — Context Entry

assignments.description: Inside Loop_GCS_CustomBuildFromRepeater. For each RepeaterItem on Scheduled_rep_CustomInstallments.AllItems, builds one Yearly N=1 GiftCommitmentSchedule linked to the parent commitment. Mirrors Assign_GCS_Simple_Row (TransactionPeriod=Yearly, TransactionInterval=1, Type=CreateTransactions, TransactionDay clamped for day-29-31 via formula, EndDate clamped forward for past-dated rows via formula) but reads per-row Amount and Date from the RepeaterItem. PaymentMethod comes from Scheduled_pk_PaymentMethod. Appended to col_GCS_Custom for bulk insert by Create_GCS_Custom.
assignments.name: Assign_GCS_Custom_Row
assignments.label: GC Schedule — Custom Row (Yearly N=1)

assignments.description: Inside Loop_GT_CustomBuild. For each row of col_GCS_Custom (Id-stamped after Create_GCS_Custom), builds one Expected GiftTransaction linked to the parent commitment AND its per-row GCS via GiftCommitmentScheduleId. Uses the shared PaymentMethod from Screen_Scheduled_Details, the donor Account id (recordId), and the per-row date + amount from rsv_GCS_CustomLoopItem. Runs only on past-dated rows (see Decide_GCS_Custom_PastDate_Needs_GT); future-dated rows are fanned out by Process_Custom_Commitment. FQS_Gift_Transaction_Category__c='Pledge Payment' matches the platform-produced GT category. CampaignId is deliberately NOT propagated from the parent GC — reading rsv_GC.CampaignId throws when the user skipped the Campaign picker ([[flow-unread-sobject-field-throws]]); reports still roll up via GiftCommitmentId.
assignments.name: Assign_GT_Custom_Row
assignments.label: G. Transaction — Custom Row (from Repeater)

assignments.description: Seeds col_GCS_TemplateRows with a single empty GiftCommitmentSchedule template row before Details_Scheduled renders. The Repeater on that screen binds to col_GCS_TemplateRows; without at least one seed row it renders empty and the user can't see the fields until they click Add. The template row is used only for the Repeater's field-default binding — its values are never inserted. Also clears col_GT_Custom so a Back-nav re-entry rebuilds cleanly.
assignments.name: Assign_GCS_Custom_SeedFirstRow
assignments.label: GC Schedule — Seed First Custom Row

assignments.description: Cash-flow path (non-In-Kind). Writes SinglePayment_num_Amount to OriginalAmount — the platform derives CurrentAmount from OriginalAmount on insert and derives TaxDeductionAmount from CurrentAmount − NonTaxDeductibleAmount, so neither is written here. Writes SinglePayment_dt_Gift to TransactionDate and TransactionDueDate, SinglePayment_dt_DonorTax to FQS_Donor_Tax_Date__c, and SinglePayment_dt_Release to FQS_Restriction_Release_Date__c. Connects to Create_GT.
assignments.name: Assign_GT_Fanout_Amount
assignments.label: G. Transaction — Fan Out Amount

assignments.description: Event Registration fanout. Writes the full payment to OriginalAmount (so hard-credit rollups reflect what changed hands) and the material-benefit portion (SinglePayment_num_EventRegBenefit) to NonTaxDeductibleAmount. Platform-derived TaxDeductionAmount then lands at OriginalAmount − NonTaxDeductibleAmount, giving the donor their partial deduction automatically. SinglePayment_num_EventRegBenefit is required on Screen_Gift_Details when Intro_pk_LeafSpecial=EventRegistration, so it is never null here. Connects to Create_GT.
assignments.name: Assign_GT_EventRegistration_Fanout_Amount
assignments.label: G. Transaction — Fan Out Amount (Event Registration)

assignments.description: In-Kind path. OriginalAmount=0 (platform-derived CurrentAmount is also 0, keeping hard-credit rollups cash-only). FMV comes from SinglePayment_num_EventRegBenefit — the same admin-visible "Fair Market Value Amount" input reused across the In-Kind and Event Registration leaves via visibility rule — and is written to FQS_Fair_Market_Value_Amount__c. NonTaxDeductibleAmount is explicitly zeroed so the platform-derived TaxDeductionAmount also lands at 0; the donor determines the actual deductible value on their own return. TransactionDate and TransactionDueDate both come from SinglePayment_dt_Gift. Connects to Create_GT.
assignments.name: Assign_GT_InKind_Fanout_Amount
assignments.label: G. Transaction — Fan Out Amount (In-Kind)

assignments.description: GDSC-to-GSC fanout router body for the Pledge Payment leaf. Stamps var_GC_GDSC_FanoutParentId = rsv_GC_Selected.Id (the picked GC from Screen_Pick_Commitment, always populated on PP). Downstream Get_GDSC_ForGC queries GDSCs off this Id; connects (GoTo) to Get_GSC_ExistingOnGT.
assignments.name: Assign_GDSC_Fanout_ParentId_FromGC_Picked
assignments.label: G. Default Soft Credit — Fanout Parent Id (from picked GC)

assignments.description: GDSC-to-GSC fanout router body for the Recurring first-payment leaf. Stamps var_GC_GDSC_FanoutParentId = rsv_GC.Id (the just-created Recurring GC). Downstream Get_GDSC_ForGC queries GDSCs off this Id so the GDSC the user opted into on Screen_Recurring_Details is mirrored onto the first payment as a GSC. Connects to Get_GSC_ExistingOnGT.
assignments.name: Assign_GDSC_Fanout_ParentId_FromGC_New
assignments.label: G. Default Soft Credit — Fanout Parent Id (from new GC)

assignments.description: Stages the platform-auto GDD row (Get_GDD_ForGC) for Update_GDD_FromResolver, rewriting its GiftDesignationId to var_GD_ResolvedId — the resolver's pick, which on Override paths is the user's manual pick. AllocatedPercentage is preserved because the platform's auto-insert always uses 100 in the single-GDD case; multi-GDD is filtered out upstream via the reconciliation gate. Connects to Update_GDD_FromResolver.
assignments.name: Assign_GC_GDD_Update_Fields
assignments.label: G. Commitment — Stage GDD Update

assignments.description: Router body when the user checked PickGDSC_chk_UseLookup and picked via the fallback flowruntime:lookup. Copies PickGDSC_lkp_Recipient.recordId into var_GDSC_RecipientId, which Assign_GDSC_Base reads. Connects to Assign_GDSC_Base.
assignments.name: Assign_GDSC_Recipient_FromLookup
assignments.label: G. Default Soft Credit — Recipient from Lookup

assignments.description: Router body when the user picked from the reach datatable. Copies rsv_Acct_SelectedGDSC.Id into var_GDSC_RecipientId, which Assign_GDSC_Base reads. Connects to Assign_GDSC_Base.
assignments.name: Assign_GDSC_Recipient_FromTable
assignments.label: G. Default Soft Credit — Recipient from Table

assignments.description: Pre-populates rsv_GT before Screen_Gift_Details renders. ObjectProvided screen fields display the record variable's current value as the shown default, so seeding TransactionDate and PaymentMethod here makes the defaults visible on the screen. Also guards the Name formula: without a TransactionDate seed the Name concatenation yields null and Create_GT fails with REQUIRED_FIELD_MISSING [Name]. The assigned value is an IsNull-gated formula (formulaDefault_TransactionDate / formulaDefault_PaymentMethod) that returns the existing value when non-null, else the fallback default (TODAY / Cash) — preserving prefilled values (e.g. Get_GCS_ForGC.PaymentMethod=ACH from Assign_GCS_Prefill_Amount) instead of stomping them. Connects to Details_SinglePayment.
assignments.name: Assign_GT_Details_Defaults
assignments.label: G. Transaction — Details Defaults

assignments.description: Applies rsv_Camp_Selected.Id onto rsv_GC.CampaignId before Create_GC_Pledge. If none selected, CampaignId stays null.
assignments.name: Assign_GC_Campaign
assignments.label: G. Commitment — Stamp Campaign

assignments.description: Stages rsv_GC for a Simple Pledge / Grant. Sets DonorId, category from Pledge_pk_Subcategory, Status='Active', FormalCommitmentType from Pledge_pk_FormalType, ExpectedTotalCmtAmount from Pledge_num_Amount, ExpectedEndDate from Pledge_dt_ExpectedEnd, EffectiveStartDate from Pledge_dt_EffectiveStart, RecurrenceType='FixedLength', IsAssetTransferExpected=false, FQS_Match_Eligible__c from the formula, and Name from the formula. ScheduleType is intentionally unset — the platform back-fills it from the Yearly N=1 GCS inserted by Assign_GCS_Simple_Row → Create_GCS_Simple → Process_Simple_Commitment ([[pledge-requires-gcs]]). NextTransaction* are left null so the platform derives them from the child GCS. Connects (GoTo) to Assign_Resolver_Inputs.
assignments.name: Assign_GC_Pledge_Defaults
assignments.label: G. Commitment — Simple Pledge / Grant Defaults

assignments.description: Prefills Screen_Gift_Details from the picked commitment's schedule row. Get_GCS_ForGC.TransactionAmount lands on var_GT_OriginalAmount (Amount input default); Get_GCS_ForGC.PaymentMethod lands on rsv_GT.PaymentMethod (Payment Method picklist default). Assign_GT_Details_Defaults downstream reads these via IsNull-gated formulas so non-null prefilled values survive. Connects (GoTo) to Assign_GT_Details_Defaults.
assignments.name: Assign_GCS_Prefill_Amount
assignments.label: GC Schedule — Prefill Amount

assignments.description: Preselect stager for purposeful launcher surfaces. Runs only when preselectCategory is set (e.g. Opportunity Setup Commitment path). Copies the caller-supplied preselectCategory and preselectLeaf into the canonical effective vars (varCategoryEffective / varLeafFutureEffective) so every downstream decision reads the same value regardless of entry surface. Cannot write to Intro_pk_LeafFuture / Intro_pk_Category directly — screen-field auto-vars are unwritable from every external mechanism ([[flow-screen-autovar-subflow-input]]). Connects to Get_Acct; Decide_Screen_Skip_Category's HasPreselect rule then jumps past Screen_Category.
assignments.name: Assign_Preselect_Effectives
assignments.label: Preselect — Stage Effectives

assignments.description: Stages rsv_GC for a Recurring Gift. Differs from Assign_GC_Scheduled_Defaults in two ways: RecurrenceType='OpenEnded' (not FixedLength) is the platform contract for open-ended gift streams, and ExpectedTotalCmtAmount is omitted because recurring gifts have no fixed total. Category is hard-set to 'Recurring Gift' (no subcategory picker on the Recurring screen); EffectiveStartDate reuses Recurring_dt_Start; IsAssetTransferExpected=false. GC.ScheduleType is intentionally not set — the platform back-fills it from the child GCS row inserted by Assign_GCS_Recurring_Row → Create_GCS_Recurring. Connects to Decide_Match_Needed_Recurring.
assignments.name: Assign_GC_Recurring_Defaults
assignments.label: G. Commitment — Recurring Defaults

assignments.description: Stages rsv_GT for the first-payment GT the Recurring leaf posts today. GiftCommitmentId=rsv_GC.Id (safe — Create_GC_Pledge already returned it); Status='Paid' because FQS is retroactive (the donor already paid today); TransactionDate + TransactionDueDate from Recurring_dt_Start (validated ≤ TODAY on Screen_Recurring_Details); OriginalAmount from Recurring_num_Amount; PaymentMethod from Recurring_pk_PaymentMethod; Category='Recurring Gift Payment'. Name is left null so FQS_Auto_Name_Gift_Transaction fills it. Deliberately does NOT write GiftType (platform derives from DonorId) or CampaignId — reading rsv_GC.CampaignId is unsafe when the campaign screen is skipped ([[flow-unread-sobject-field-throws]]). Connects to Create_GT_RecurringFirstPayment.
assignments.name: Assign_Recurring_First_Payment_Defaults
assignments.label: Defaults: Recurring First Payment GT

assignments.description: Builds the single open-ended GiftCommitmentSchedule row for a Recurring Gift. Type='CreateTransactions' tells the platform to fan out Expected GTs per TransactionPeriod / TransactionInterval / TransactionAmount / StartDate. No EndDate — the schedule is open-ended and continues until the donor cancels (commitment deactivation). Combined with GC.RecurrenceType='OpenEnded' from Assign_GC_Recurring_Defaults, the null EndDate keeps the stream running. TransactionDay comes from formulaRecurringTransactionDay to prevent day-of-month drift. Connects to Create_GCS_Recurring.
assignments.name: Assign_GCS_Recurring_Row
assignments.label: GC Schedule — Recurring Row

assignments.description: Stages rsv_GC for a Regular Scheduled Pledge / Grant. Same skeleton as Assign_GC_Pledge_Defaults but the schedule engine populates NextTransactionDate / NextTransactionAmount from the child GCS row inserted by Assign_GCS_Scheduled_Row → Create_GCS_Scheduled, so they are omitted here. Category from Scheduled_pk_Subcategory; FormalCommitmentType from Scheduled_pk_FormalType; ExpectedTotalCmtAmount from Scheduled_num_Total; RecurrenceType='FixedLength'; EffectiveStartDate from Scheduled_dt_EffectiveStart; IsAssetTransferExpected=false. GC.ScheduleType is intentionally unset — platform-managed, back-fills from the child GCS. Connects (GoTo) to Assign_Resolver_Inputs.
assignments.name: Assign_GC_Scheduled_Defaults
assignments.label: G. Commitment — Scheduled Pledge / Grant Defaults

assignments.description: Builds the single GiftCommitmentSchedule row for a Regular Scheduled Pledge / Grant. Type='CreateTransactions' engages the fanout engine per TransactionPeriod / TransactionInterval / TransactionAmount / StartDate / EndDate; TransactionDay from formulaScheduledTransactionDay prevents day-of-month drift. Combined with GC.RecurrenceType='FixedLength' from Assign_GC_Scheduled_Defaults and the EndDate on GCS, the schedule is bounded. FundFirst's GiftCommitmentSchedule has no ScheduleType field — recurrence semantics ride entirely on TransactionPeriod + TransactionInterval + StartDate/EndDate ([[fundfirst-gcs-no-scheduletype]], [[fqs-crt-deploy-pattern]]). Connects to Create_GCS_Scheduled.
assignments.name: Assign_GCS_Scheduled_Row
assignments.label: GC Schedule — Scheduled Row

assignments.description: Screen-auto-var mirror. Runs immediately after Screen_Category on the normal (Home / Account) path — the point where Intro_pk_Category and Intro_pk_LeafFuture have just been populated by the user's picks. Copies them into varCategoryEffective + varLeafFutureEffective so every downstream decision reads the same canonical variable regardless of entry surface. On the preselect path this element is skipped (Assign_Preselect_Effectives has already seeded the effectives); on the GC-context path Decide_Screen_Skip_Category jumps past Screen_Category entirely. Connects to Get_CampaignMember_ForAcct so the member-campaign chain fires after the first screen renders (keeps cold-path SOQL out of the pre-first-screen budget).
assignments.name: Assign_Preselect_ScreenAuto_To_Effectives
assignments.label: Preselect — Mirror Category Auto-Vars to Effectives

assignments.description: Hand-authors an Expected GT for past-dated Simple pledges (runs only when Pledge_dt_ExpectedEnd < TODAY per Decide_GT_Simple_PastDate_Needs_GT). Parents to both the just-created GC and its GCS so the GT rolls up on both sides — mirroring what the platform fanout produces for future-dated pledges. TransactionDate + TransactionDueDate use the user's original past date (not the clamped GCS.EndDate) so the record shows the correct due date. Status='Unpaid' so the downstream Pledge Payment leaf can find and update the row when the money arrives. Category='Pledge Payment' matches the fanout-produced GT's category (from FQS_Auto_Category_Gift_Transaction); Name is left null so FQS_Auto_Name_Gift_Transaction fills it. Connects to Create_GT_SimplePastDate.
assignments.name: Assign_GT_Simple_PastDate
assignments.label: G. Transaction — Simple Past-Date Expected

assignments.description: Builds the single-installment (N=1) GiftCommitmentSchedule row for a Simple Pledge / Grant. TransactionPeriod='Yearly' + TransactionInterval=1 + StartDate=Pledge_dt_ExpectedEnd anchors the (only) Expected GT's TransactionDueDate; EndDate=formulaSimpleGCSEndDate clamps forward to TODAY when the pledge date is in the past so the fanout window still generates a GT (past-date-only-window schedules produce zero GTs otherwise). TransactionDay=formulaSimpleTransactionDay prevents day-of-month drift; Type='CreateTransactions' engages platform fanout; PaymentMethod from Pledge_pk_PaymentMethod. Yearly is the only viable shape for Flow inputReference inserts on a Simple pledge — Custom-period GCS does not trigger fanout from Flow ([[fundfirst-custom-schedule-shape]]). Connects to Create_GCS_Simple.
assignments.name: Assign_GCS_Simple_Row
assignments.label: GC Schedule — Simple Row (N=1)

assignments.name: Assign_GSC_From_Lookup
assignments.label: G. Soft Credit — Use Looked-Up Recipient

assignments.description: Partial path — writes PartialPercent from SoftCreditAmount_num_Percent (raw Number screen input, since ObjectProvided binding to a Percent-typed field is not supported in Screen Flows). PartialAmount is deliberately left null so the platform derives SoftCreditAmount = GT.OriginalAmount × PartialPercent / 100. Connects to Get_GSC_ExistingOnDonorGT_ForRecipient (enforces [[giftsoftcredit-unique-gt-recipient]]).
assignments.name: Assign_GSC_Partial
assignments.label: G. Soft Credit — Partial

assignments.description: Prepares rsv_GT for the update-existing-Expected-GT path on Pledge Payment. Writes rsv_GT.Id = rsv_GT_Selected.Id (which is what makes Update_GT target the selected row instead of inserting) and Status='Paid' (the semantic transition — the payment has landed). Also carries the split-date inputs (SinglePayment_dt_Gift → TransactionDate, SinglePayment_dt_DonorTax → FQS_Donor_Tax_Date__c). Deliberately does NOT touch OriginalAmount (preserved even on mismatch — user manages upgrades on the GC record), CurrentAmount (platform-computed rollup, silently ignored on write), or TransactionDueDate (the schedule's original due date, kept as-is for historical reporting).
assignments.name: Assign_GT_Update_Existing
assignments.label: G. Transaction — Prepare Update Existing

assignments.description: Caller-side projection layer for the Campaign+Designation resolver subflow. Copies screen auto-vars (Intro_pk_LeafMonetary, Intro_pk_LeafSpecial, UseExistingSched_pk_Mode) into real Flow variables that can be passed as subflow inputs — screen auto-vars are unwritable from Assign/subflow-input mechanisms per [[flow-screen-autovar-subflow-input]], so the projection layer is mandatory. Connects to Subflow_Call_Campaign_Designation_Resolver.
assignments.name: Assign_Resolver_Inputs
assignments.label: Resolver — Project screen auto-vars

assignments.description: Post-subflow assign. Stamps rsv_Camp_Selected.Id from var_ResolverOutput_SelectedCampaignId. Runs only on the Accepted branch out of Decide_Resolver_Return_Router. Connects to Decide_GTD_After.
assignments.name: Assign_Resolver_Selected_Campaign
assignments.label: Resolver — Stamp Selected Campaign Id

assignments.description: Match subflow resolveEmployer-stage input projection. Screen auto-vars can't be passed to a subflow directly ([[flow-screen-autovar-subflow-input]]), so this Assign projects the caller-side donor amount into var_GT_DonorAmount via formulaCallerDonorGiftAmount (BLANKVALUE(SinglePayment_num_Amount, Recurring_num_Amount)); the subflow reads it as in_donorGiftAmount. Landing point from Decide_Match_Needed_Yes (Outright / PP) and Decide_Match_Needed_Recurring_Yes. Connects to Subflow_Call_Match_Resolve.
assignments.name: Assign_Match_Inputs_Resolve
assignments.label: Match — Inputs (Resolve)

assignments.description: Post-resolveEmployer stash. Resets var_MatchApplied=false so the createAndPair invocation starts from a clean flag; the subflow's four resolveEmployer outputs are already on monolith-scope vars via the subflow's outputAssignments. Necessary because Details_MatchAmount lives inside the subflow — the caller can't rely on prior screen state (numMatchAmount / pkMatchReceived would be blank on a second call). Connects to Decide_Match_Resolve_Return.
assignments.name: Assign_Match_Stash_Resolve_Outputs
assignments.label: Match — Stash Resolve Outputs

assignments.description: Match subflow createAndPair-stage input projection. Runs after donor GT insert or update (post-Create_GT / post-Update_GT). Sets var_MatchApplied=false as a defensive reset; the subflow-call element handles all input marshalling itself. Exists as a stable connector target so entry-point decisions have a single rewire point and downstream Decide_Match_Subflow_Error routing is a single node. Connects to Subflow_Call_Match_CreateAndPair.
assignments.name: Assign_Match_Inputs_CreateAndPair
assignments.label: Match — Inputs (CreateAndPair)

decisions.description: After Process_Simple_Commitment activates the schedule, decides whether the launcher must hand-author the Expected GT. Future-dated pledges (Pledge_dt_ExpectedEnd ≥ TODAY) skip to Get_GT_PastDue because the platform fanout already produced the GT. Past-dated pledges (Pledge_dt_ExpectedEnd < TODAY) → Assign_GT_Simple_PastDate builds a compensating Expected GT — the platform activates the schedule and populates CurrentGiftCmtScheduleId but does NOT fan out a GT because the engine assumes past-due money should already be recorded as Paid, not Expected.
decisions.name: Decide_GT_Simple_PastDate_Needs_GT

decisions.description: Category-skip router. Three entry paths converge here: (a) GC-entry (contextCommitmentId set) — rule IsGCContext jumps to Get_GCS_ForGC because Assign_GC_Context_Entry has already staged the Pledge Payment leaf and PP screens inherit Campaign from the commitment via Get_Camp_ForGC rather than the member-campaign list; (b) preselect entry (preselectCategory set — purposeful launcher surface) — rule HasPreselect targets Get_CampaignMember_ForAcct so the campaign chain loads before Decide_Screen_Category, then routes on varCategoryEffective + varLeafFutureEffective already seeded by Assign_Preselect_Effectives; (c) default (Home / Account entry) → Intro_ChooseCategoryAndLeaf which walks the user through Screen_Category. Rule ordering matters: GC-context first (most restrictive), then preselect, then default.
decisions.name: Decide_Screen_Skip_Category
