Flow.description: Screen flow launched via quick action from an Account record. Records either a GiftTransaction (Outright, In-Kind, Earned Income, or Pledge Payment) or a new GiftCommitment (Pledge). Every path uses record variables bound to the record-creates via inputReference. Pickers (Commitment, Campaign, Designation, Soft-Credit Account) are datatables with a native lookup escape hatch. Restriction handling on the Pledge branch is driven by GiftCommitment.FulfillmentType. Every DML has a fault path to a single error screen so the user always sees why nothing was saved.

formulas.description: Actionable delta line for the amount-mismatch warning: "That's $X more/less than the scheduled amount." Defensively guards on both operands non-blank.
formulas.name: formulaAmountMismatchDelta
formulas.expression: IF(OR(ISBLANK({!SinglePayment_num_Amount}), ISBLANK({!rsv_GT_Selected.OriginalAmount})), "", IF({!SinglePayment_num_Amount} > {!rsv_GT_Selected.OriginalAmount}, "That's $" & TEXT(ROUND({!SinglePayment_num_Amount} - {!rsv_GT_Selected.OriginalAmount}, 2)) & " more than the scheduled amount.", "That's $" & TEXT(ROUND({!rsv_GT_Selected.OriginalAmount} - {!SinglePayment_num_Amount}, 2)) & " less than the scheduled amount."))

formulas.description: Per-installment GCS.EndDate for the Custom branch. Future dates pass through; past dates clamp forward to TODAY so the platform's fanout window includes at least one open day. Reads the current Loop_GCS_CustomBuildFromRepeater cursor.
formulas.name: formulaCustomGCSEndDate

formulas.description: Per-installment GCS.TransactionDay picklist ("1".."31" + "LastDay") for the Custom branch. Clamps 29/30/31 to "LastDay" because the picklist rejects those days for short months. Reads the current Loop_GCS_CustomBuildFromRepeater cursor.
formulas.name: formulaCustomGCSTransactionDay

formulas.description: Derives GiftTransaction.GiftType for a Custom-branch installment from Get_Acct.IsPersonAccount: Person Account → Individual, else Organizational.
formulas.name: formulaCustomGiftType

formulas.description: Derives FQS_Gift_Transaction_Category__c for each Custom-branch Expected GT from Scheduled_pk_Subcategory: "Grant Payout" → "Grant Payment", else "Pledge Payment". Parity with FQS_Auto_Category_Gift_Transaction on the platform-fanned Regular installments.
formulas.name: formulaCustomGTCategory

formulas.description: Name for each Custom-branch hand-authored past-date Expected GT built inside Loop_GT_CustomBuild. Pattern: "<Donor Name> - $<Amount> due <Date>". Reads rsv_GCS_CustomLoopItem so each compensating GT parents to its specific inserted GCS.
formulas.name: formulaCustomGTName

formulas.description: Preserves rsv_GT.PaymentMethod when prefilled by Assign_GCS_Prefill_Amount from Get_GCS_ForGC; else defaults to Cash. Used by Assign_GT_Details_Defaults on the update-existing-GT branch of Pledge Payment.
formulas.name: formulaDefault_PaymentMethod

formulas.description: Preserves rsv_GT.TransactionDate when prefilled by Assign_GCS_Prefill_Amount; else defaults to TODAY. Used by Assign_GT_Details_Defaults on the update-existing-GT branch of Pledge Payment.
formulas.name: formulaDefault_TransactionDate

formulas.description: Renders SinglePayment_num_Amount as "$250.00" for the amount-mismatch warning and PP-update confirmation. ROUND wrapped in TEXT() forces two-decimal display; bare TEXT() drops trailing zeros.
formulas.name: formulaDisplay_NumGiftAmount

formulas.description: Renders rsv_GT_Selected.OriginalAmount as "$250.00" for the amount-mismatch warning. Same ROUND/TEXT pattern as formulaDisplay_NumGiftAmount; ISBLANK guard is defensive against [[flow-unread-sobject-field-throws]].
formulas.name: formulaDisplay_OriginalAmount

formulas.description: Renders rsv_GT.PaymentMethod picklist as a plain string for the PP-update confirmation. TEXT() required for picklist read [[flow-formula-picklist-comparison]]; falls back to "Cash" matching the flow-wide default.
formulas.name: formulaDisplay_PaymentMethod

formulas.description: Renders rsv_GT_Selected.TransactionDueDate as "Mon DD, YYYY" for the PP-update confirmation. ISBLANK guard is defensive against [[flow-unread-sobject-field-throws]] — UseExistingSched_tbl_Existing already declares the column.
formulas.name: formulaDisplay_TransactionDueDate

formulas.description: Auto-generated Name for a new GiftCommitment: "<Donor Name> - <Amount> <Category>". Category reads rsv_GC.FQS_Gift_Commitment_Category__c stringValue (not the RadioButton choiceText which includes an em-dash description) [[flow-radio-stores-choicetext]].
formulas.name: formulaGiftCommitmentName

formulas.description: Auto-generated Name for a one-time GiftTransaction (Outright, In-Kind, Earned Income, Event Registration): "<Donor Name> <Amount> <Date>". BLANKVALUE prefers SinglePayment_dt_Gift (Screen_Gift_Details input) and falls back to rsv_GT.TransactionDate (In-Kind ObjectProvided binding).
formulas.name: formulaGiftTransactionName_OneTime

formulas.description: Auto-generated Name for a Pledge Payment GiftTransaction: "<Donor Name> <Amount> <Date>". BLANKVALUE prefers SinglePayment_dt_Gift and falls back to rsv_GT.TransactionDate.
formulas.name: formulaGiftTransactionName_Recurring

formulas.description: Maps the Simple-Pledge Match-Eligible radio (Pledge_pk_MatchEligible) to a Boolean for rsv_GC.FQS_Match_Eligible__c. Yes → true; No or null → false. ISBLANK guard coerces null (radio hidden on Corp accounts) to false, else the Boolean insert rejects with INVALID_TYPE_ON_FIELD_IN_RECORD.
formulas.name: formulaMatchEligible_Pledge

formulas.description: Maps the Recurring Match-Eligible radio (Recurring_pk_MatchEligible) to a Boolean for rsv_GC.FQS_Match_Eligible__c. See formulaMatchEligible_Pledge.
formulas.name: formulaMatchEligible_Recurring

formulas.description: Maps the Scheduled Match-Eligible radio (Scheduled_pk_MatchEligible) to a Boolean for rsv_GC.FQS_Match_Eligible__c. See formulaMatchEligible_Pledge.
formulas.name: formulaMatchEligible_Scheduled

formulas.description: Auto-generated Name for a Recurring Gift commitment. No fixed total (open-ended); prints installment amount + period word so the record is scannable in list views. Category is literal "Recurring Gift" from Assign_GC_Recurring_Defaults.
formulas.name: formulaRecurringCommitmentName

formulas.description: Interval word ("every", "every other", "every third"...) for the Recurring preview sentence. Mirrors formulaScheduledIntervalWord.
formulas.name: formulaRecurringIntervalWord
formulas.expression: CASE(LEFT(TEXT({!Recurring_num_Interval}), 1), "1", "every", "2", "every other", "3", "every third", "4", "every fourth", "5", "every fifth", "6", "every sixth", "7", "every seventh", "8", "every eighth", "")

formulas.description: Period lowercase for Recurring commitment Name and preview sentence ("every month" not "every Monthly").
formulas.name: formulaRecurringPeriodWord

formulas.description: Full plain-English recurring schedule preview for the DisplayText field. Open-ended — no total, no end date, no payment count.
formulas.name: formulaRecurringPreviewText
formulas.expression: "The donor will give " & IF(ISBLANK({!Recurring_num_Amount}), "$___", "$" & TEXT({!Recurring_num_Amount})) & " " & IF(ISBLANK({!formulaRecurringIntervalWord}), "___", {!formulaRecurringIntervalWord}) & " " & IF(ISBLANK({!formulaRecurringPeriodWord}), "___", {!formulaRecurringPeriodWord}) & " starting " & {!formulaRecurringStartDateDisplay} & ", continuing indefinitely until the donor cancels."

formulas.description: Friendly-formats Recurring_dt_Start as "Mon DD, YYYY" for the preview sentence.
formulas.name: formulaRecurringStartDateDisplay

formulas.description: Day-of-month from Recurring_dt_Start for GiftCommitmentSchedule.TransactionDay (a String picklist of "1".."31"). Without this, Monthly schedules default to day 1 for every payment after the first [[gc-current-schedule-activation]].
formulas.name: formulaRecurringTransactionDay

formulas.description: Auto-generated Name for a Scheduled Pledge/Grant GiftCommitment. Pattern mirrors formulaGiftCommitmentName but reads Scheduled_num_Total. Category comes from rsv_GC.FQS_Gift_Commitment_Category__c stringValue, not the RadioButton choiceText [[flow-radio-stores-choicetext]].
formulas.name: formulaScheduledCommitmentName

formulas.description: Computes final payment date: StartDate + (Interval * Period) * (Count - 1). Weekly = 7 days per unit; Monthly = ADDMONTHS 1 per unit; Yearly = ADDMONTHS 12 per unit. Null-safe.
formulas.name: formulaScheduledEndDate
formulas.expression: IF(OR(ISBLANK({!Scheduled_dt_Start}), ISBLANK({!Scheduled_num_PaymentCount}), {!Scheduled_num_PaymentCount} <= 1), {!Scheduled_dt_Start}, IF({!Scheduled_pk_Period} = "Weekly", {!Scheduled_dt_Start} + ({!Scheduled_num_Interval} * ({!Scheduled_num_PaymentCount} - 1) * 7), IF({!Scheduled_pk_Period} = "Monthly", ADDMONTHS({!Scheduled_dt_Start}, {!Scheduled_num_Interval} * ({!Scheduled_num_PaymentCount} - 1)), IF({!Scheduled_pk_Period} = "Yearly", ADDMONTHS({!Scheduled_dt_Start}, {!Scheduled_num_Interval} * ({!Scheduled_num_PaymentCount} - 1) * 12), {!Scheduled_dt_Start}))))

formulas.description: Friendly-formats formulaScheduledEndDate as "Mon DD, YYYY" for the preview sentence.
formulas.name: formulaScheduledEndDateDisplay

formulas.description: Recurring installment amount: Total / Count, floored to cents so N * installment <= Total; the last real payment absorbs any leftover. FLOOR(x*100)/100 avoids floating-point $0.005 drift.
formulas.name: formulaScheduledInstallmentAmount

formulas.description: Interval word ("every", "every other", ...) for the Scheduled preview sentence — maps the Scheduled_num_Interval numeric multiplier back to the display word.
formulas.name: formulaScheduledIntervalWord
formulas.expression: CASE(LEFT(TEXT({!Scheduled_num_Interval}), 1), "1", "every", "2", "every other", "3", "every third", "4", "every fourth", "5", "every fifth", "6", "every sixth", "7", "every seventh", "8", "every eighth", "")

formulas.description: Period lowercase for the Scheduled preview sentence ("every third month" not "every third Monthly"). Handles the trailing s: month/week/year, not months.
formulas.name: formulaScheduledPeriodWord

formulas.description: Full plain-English schedule preview for the DisplayText field. Uses Mon DD, YYYY date formatting via formulaScheduledStartDateDisplay / formulaScheduledEndDateDisplay so dates read as prose, not ISO. Each token has a ___ fallback so partial input still shows the sentence structure.
formulas.name: formulaScheduledPreviewText
formulas.expression: "The donor will give " & IF(ISBLANK({!formulaScheduledInstallmentAmount}), "$___", "$" & TEXT({!formulaScheduledInstallmentAmount})) & " " & IF(ISBLANK({!formulaScheduledIntervalWord}), "___", {!formulaScheduledIntervalWord}) & " " & IF(ISBLANK({!formulaScheduledPeriodWord}), "___", {!formulaScheduledPeriodWord}) & " starting " & {!formulaScheduledStartDateDisplay} & " until " & IF(ISBLANK({!Scheduled_num_Total}), "$___", "$" & TEXT({!Scheduled_num_Total})) & " is given, over " & IF(OR(ISBLANK({!Scheduled_num_PaymentCount}), {!Scheduled_num_PaymentCount} <= 0), "___", TEXT({!Scheduled_num_PaymentCount})) & " payments. Final payment expected around " & {!formulaScheduledEndDateDisplay} & ". If total does not divide evenly, the last payment absorbs the remainder."

formulas.description: Friendly-formats Scheduled_dt_Start as "Mon DD, YYYY" for the preview sentence. Flow TEXT(date) emits yyyy-mm-dd which is unpleasant in prose.
formulas.name: formulaScheduledStartDateDisplay

formulas.description: Day-of-month from Scheduled_dt_Start for GiftCommitmentSchedule.TransactionDay. Prevents day-1-of-month drift on the Scheduled Pledge/Grant leaf. Mirrors formulaRecurringTransactionDay.
formulas.name: formulaScheduledTransactionDay

formulas.description: GCS.EndDate for the Simple leaf. Future-dated pledges pass through; past-dated pledges clamp forward to TODAY so the platform's fanout window includes at least one open day and generates the Expected GT. The Expected GT still lands with TransactionDueDate = GCS.StartDate = Pledge_dt_ExpectedEnd, so the user-facing due date remains the original past date.
formulas.name: formulaSimpleGCSEndDate

formulas.description: Derives FQS_Gift_Transaction_Category__c for the hand-authored past-date Expected GT on the Single-Payment pledge/grant leaf. Reads Pledge_pk_Subcategory: "Grant Payout" → "Grant Payment", else "Pledge Payment".
formulas.name: formulaSimplePastDateGTCategory

formulas.description: Plain-English summary of the single-installment pledge/grant. Reads Pledge_num_Amount + Pledge_dt_ExpectedEnd on Screen_Pledge_Details.
formulas.name: formulaSimplePreviewText
formulas.expression: "The donor will give " & IF(ISBLANK({!Pledge_num_Amount}), "$___", "$" & TEXT({!Pledge_num_Amount})) & " on " & {!formulaSimpleStartDateDisplay} & " as a single payment."

formulas.description: Friendly-formats Pledge_dt_ExpectedEnd as "Mon DD, YYYY" for the Simple Pledge preview sentence.
formulas.name: formulaSimpleStartDateDisplay

formulas.description: Day-of-month from Pledge_dt_ExpectedEnd for GiftCommitmentSchedule.TransactionDay (picklist "1".."31" + "LastDay"). Clamps 29/30/31 to "LastDay" because the platform rejects those days for short months [[gc-current-schedule-activation]].
formulas.name: formulaSimpleTransactionDay

formulas.description: Per-row GTD Amount for the multi-GDD split fanout: rsv_GT.OriginalAmount * rsv_GDD_SplitLoopItem.AllocatedPercentage / 100, rounded to 2 decimals. Returns 0 when OriginalAmount is null.
formulas.name: formulaSplitGTDAmount

formulas.description: Renders a leaf-specific one-line summary sentence for Screen_Success. References ONLY top-level scalar variables (pkLeaf*, num*, dt*) — never SObject field-paths — so it evaluates safely on every terminal path without tripping [[flow-unread-sobject-field-throws]]. The three leaf radios (Intro_pk_LeafMonetary / Intro_pk_LeafFuture / Intro_pk_LeafSpecial) are mutually exclusive per run, so BLANKVALUE(BLANKVALUE(monetary, future), special) yields the single CASE key. Monetary + special paths use TODAY() rather than rsv_GT.TransactionDate (unreadable cross-path); accurate for the default case and off by a few days for backdated entries.
formulas.name: formulaSuccessSummary
formulas.expression: CASE(BLANKVALUE(BLANKVALUE({!Intro_pk_LeafMonetary}, {!Intro_pk_LeafFuture}), {!Intro_pk_LeafSpecial}), "Outright", "Recorded a $" & TEXT(ROUND(BLANKVALUE({!SinglePayment_num_Amount}, 0), 2)) & " Outright Gift on " & {!formulaTodayDisplay} & ".", "PledgePayment", "Recorded a $" & TEXT(ROUND(BLANKVALUE({!SinglePayment_num_Amount}, 0), 2)) & " Pledge Payment on " & {!formulaTodayDisplay} & ".", "Recurring", "Recorded a $" & TEXT(ROUND(BLANKVALUE({!Recurring_num_Amount}, 0), 2)) & " Recurring Gift starting " & {!formulaRecurringStartDateDisplay} & ".", "Simple", "Recorded a $" & TEXT(ROUND(BLANKVALUE({!Pledge_num_Amount}, 0), 2)) & " Single Payment Pledge/Grant.", "Scheduled", "Recorded a $" & TEXT(ROUND(BLANKVALUE({!Scheduled_num_Total}, 0), 2)) & " Scheduled Pledge/Grant starting " & {!formulaScheduledStartDateDisplay} & ".", "InKind", "Recorded a $" & TEXT(ROUND(BLANKVALUE({!SinglePayment_num_EventRegBenefit}, 0), 2)) & " In-Kind Gift on " & {!formulaTodayDisplay} & ".", "EarnedIncome", "Recorded a $" & TEXT(ROUND(BLANKVALUE({!SinglePayment_num_Amount}, 0), 2)) & " Earned Income payment on " & {!formulaTodayDisplay} & ".", "EventRegistration", "Recorded a $" & TEXT(ROUND(BLANKVALUE({!SinglePayment_num_Amount}, 0), 2)) & " Event Registration on " & {!formulaTodayDisplay} & " ($" & TEXT(ROUND(BLANKVALUE({!SinglePayment_num_EventRegBenefit}, 0), 2)) & " benefit).", "Record created.")

formulas.description: Renders TODAY() as "Mon DD, YYYY" for the Success summary on monetary + special paths where no dedicated start-date scalar exists.
formulas.name: formulaTodayDisplay

formulas.description: Caller-side leaf-agnostic donor amount — BLANKVALUE(SinglePayment_num_Amount, Recurring_num_Amount). Passed to the Employer Match subflow as in_donorGiftAmount so formulaMatchAmountDefault and Assign_MatchSoftCredit_OnDonor.PartialAmount can compute without reading screen auto-vars across the flow boundary.
formulas.name: formulaCallerDonorGiftAmount

Flow.label: FQS Guided Gift Entry — Account

loops.description: First pass over Scheduled_rep_CustomInstallments.AllItems — the synthetic RepeaterItem collection whose fields are the inner Screen field names (field_Custom_Date, field_Custom_Amount) rather than SObject field names (per [[flow-repeater-output-quirk]]). Body Assign_GCS_Custom_Row builds a fresh Yearly N=1 GCS per item and appends to col_GCS_Custom; on drain, Create_GCS_Custom bulk-inserts. No assignNextValueToReference — the current item is referenced as {!Loop_GCS_CustomBuildFromRepeater.field_Custom_Date} / .field_Custom_Amount.
loops.name: Loop_GCS_CustomBuildFromRepeater
loops.label: Loop GCS — Custom Build From Repeater

loops.description: Second pass over col_GCS_Custom after Create_GCS_Custom bulk-inserts the N Yearly N=1 GCSs and Process_Custom_Commitment activates them (platform fans out future-dated Expected GTs). Iterates the inserted GCSs to hand-author compensating Expected GTs only for past-dated rows — the platform refuses to fan those out (same rule as the Simple past-date branch). Assigns the loop cursor to rsv_GCS_CustomLoopItem so Decide_GCS_Custom_PastDate_Needs_GT can compare StartDate to TODAY and Assign_GT_Custom_Row can read TransactionAmount / StartDate / Id off it. Drains to Create_GT_CustomPastDate.
loops.name: Loop_GT_CustomBuild
loops.label: Loop GT — Custom Past-Date Build

loops.description: Iterates col_GT_SelectedPastDue — the collection the user checked on Screen_Confirm_Past_Payments (bound to the flowruntime:datatable's selectedRows output). Loop cursor is rsv_GT_ConfirmedLoopItem; body Assign_GT_Confirm_Paid_Row flips each row's Status to Paid and appends to col_GT_ConfirmedPaid. Drains to Update_GT_ConfirmedPaid, which no-ops if the user unchecked everything.
loops.name: Loop_GT_ConfirmPaid
loops.label: Loop GT — Confirm Past-Due to Paid

loops.description: Iterates Get_GDSC_ForGC (the parent GC's GDSCs) with cursor rsv_GDSC_LoopItem; body Assign_GSC_From_GDSC builds one GiftSoftCredit per GDSC parented to rsv_GT.Id and appends to col_GSC_FromGDSCs. Drains to Create_GSC_FromGDSCs for bulk insert. Reached from Decide_GDSC_Fanout_To_GSC when the leaf has a parent GC (PP or Recurring first-payment) AND Get_GDSC_ForGC returned rows. If the collection is empty, the loop drains immediately and Create_GSC_FromGDSCs inserts an empty list (no-op).
loops.name: Loop_GDSC_FanoutToGSC
loops.label: Loop GDSC — Fanout to GSC

loops.description: Iterates col_GDD_ResolverCampaign with cursor rsv_GDD_SplitLoopItem to fan out one GTD per Campaign GDD onto rsv_GT when var_GTD_PlatformSplitApplies=true and the split source is Campaign-level. Reached from Decide_GTD_Split_Source's default branch. Body Assign_GTD_Split_FromCampaign appends a per-row GTD to col_GTD_Split with Amount = rsv_GT.OriginalAmount * (AllocatedPercentage / 100); on drain, Create_GTD_Split bulk-inserts.
loops.name: Loop_GDD_ResolverCampaign_FanoutGTD
loops.label: Loop GDD (Resolver Campaign) — Fanout Split GTD

loops.description: Iterates col_GDD_ResolverGC with cursor rsv_GDD_SplitLoopItem to fan out one GTD per GC GDD onto rsv_GT (PP branch only). Body Assign_GTD_Split_FromGC appends a per-row GTD to col_GTD_Split; drains to Create_GTD_Split for bulk insert.
loops.name: Loop_GDD_ResolverGC_FanoutGTD
loops.label: Loop GDD (Resolver GC) — Fanout Split GTD

recordCreates.description: Bulk-inserts col_GCS_Custom — the N Yearly N=1 GiftCommitmentSchedule rows built by Loop_GCS_CustomBuildFromRepeater, one per user-entered installment row. Each GCS parents to rsv_GC.Id with Type=CreateTransactions so Process_Custom_Commitment can activate them and the platform fans out future-dated Expected GTs. Past-dated GCSs still land (they anchor the schedule) but the platform refuses to fan out GTs for them; Loop_GT_CustomBuild hand-authors compensating GTs on the second pass. Connector routes to Process_Custom_Commitment; fault shares Error_RecordNotSaved.
recordCreates.name: Create_GCS_Custom
recordCreates.label: Create GCSs — Custom (collection)

recordCreates.description: Bulk-inserts col_GT_Custom — the hand-authored compensating Expected GTs for past-dated Custom-branch rows. Only rows whose StartDate < TODAY reach here via Decide_GCS_Custom_PastDate_Needs_GT. Each GT already has GiftCommitmentId (parent commitment) and GiftCommitmentScheduleId (the per-row Yearly N=1 GCS just inserted by Create_GCS_Custom) stamped. The FQS_Auto_Name_Gift_Transaction before-save flow fills each GT.Name after insert. Connector routes to Get_GT_PastDue; fault shares Error_RecordNotSaved.
recordCreates.name: Create_GT_CustomPastDate
recordCreates.label: Create GTs — Custom Past-Date (collection)

recordCreates.description: Inserts the GiftTransaction via inputReference on rsv_GT, with all fields set by prior Assignments and ObjectProvided screen bindings. Connector routes to Decide_Match_Insert_Path — when no match is opted-in that decision defaults straight to Decide_GSC_InKind_SelfCredit_Create so the In-Kind self-credit / designation / soft-credit terminal chain runs unchanged. Fault shares Error_RecordNotSaved.
recordCreates.name: Create_GT
recordCreates.label: Create GT

recordCreates.description: Inserts rsv_GDSC on the just-created parent GC via inputReference. Runs on GC-creating leaves (Simple / Scheduled / Recurring) when Pledge_pk_NeedsSoftCredits=Yes. Connector routes to Decide_GDSC_Fanout_To_GSC so a matching GSC can also be fanned onto the first-payment GT. Fault shares Error_RecordNotSaved — a GDSC insert failure leaves the GC + designation state intact and the user has to add the soft credit manually.
recordCreates.name: Create_GDSC
recordCreates.label: Create GDSC

recordCreates.description: Bulk-inserts col_GSC_FromGDSCs built by Loop_GDSC_FanoutToGSC — one GiftSoftCredit per GDSC on the parent GC, all parented to rsv_GT.Id. Empty-collection case (GC had no GDSCs) is a no-op. Fault shares Error_RecordNotSaved — a failed insert leaves the just-created / just-updated GT in place; user has to add soft credits manually. Connector routes to Decide_Screen_Show_Success.
recordCreates.name: Create_GSC_FromGDSCs
recordCreates.label: Create GSCs — From GDSCs (collection)

recordCreates.description: Inserts the auto-generated self-recognition GiftSoftCredit for In-Kind gifts via rsv_GSC_InKindSelf. Ensures the donor sees the FMV in NPC's soft-credit rollups (DonorGiftSummary.TotalSoftCreditsAmount, TotalHardSoftCreditsAmount) while hard-credit rollups stay cash-only. Connector routes to Decide_GTD_Create; fault shares Error_RecordNotSaved.
recordCreates.name: Create_GSC_InKindSelf
recordCreates.label: Create GSC — In-Kind Self-Credit

recordCreates.description: Inserts the parent GiftCommitment via inputReference on rsv_GC. IMPORTANT: do NOT set rsv_GC.ScheduleType before this insert — the field is platform-managed and back-fills from the first GiftCommitmentSchedule child inserted afterwards. Setting it explicitly is silently overridden to 'Recurring' and produces a misleading error if a Custom schedule is later attached. See docs/npc-automation-notes.md § GiftCommitment.ScheduleType. Connector routes to Decide_GCS_Insert; fault shares Error_RecordNotSaved.
recordCreates.name: Create_GC_Pledge
recordCreates.label: Create GC — Pledged Commitment

recordCreates.description: Posts the Recurring commitment's first payment as a Paid GiftTransaction dated Recurring_dt_Start, via inputReference on rsv_GT. Runs after Process_Recurring_Commitment has activated the schedule and Decide_GDD_Create has run the designation fan-out. Connector routes to Decide_Match_Insert_Path so SinglePayment_pk_NeedsMatch=Yes drops into the same employer-GT + ACR + soft-credit chain that Outright and PP use. Fault shares Error_RecordNotSaved — a failed insert leaves the GC + GCS activated (the schedule engine will still fan out Expected GTs) and the user has to record the first payment manually.
recordCreates.name: Create_GT_RecurringFirstPayment
recordCreates.label: Create GT — Recurring First Payment

recordCreates.description: Inserts the open-ended GiftCommitmentSchedule row for a Recurring Gift via inputReference on rsv_GCS. Runs only when Intro_pk_LeafMonetary=Choice_Leaf_RecurringGift (see Decide_GCS_Insert_Recurring). No EndDate — the engine keeps fanning out Expected GTs indefinitely; deactivation happens by editing the commitment or its schedule row. Connector routes to Process_Recurring_Commitment to synchronously fire the Fundraising engine; fault shares Error_RecordNotSaved.
recordCreates.name: Create_GCS_Recurring
recordCreates.label: Create GCS — Recurring (open-ended)

recordCreates.description: Inserts the GiftCommitmentSchedule row for a Regular Scheduled Pledge / Grant via inputReference on rsv_GCS. Runs only when Intro_pk_LeafFuture=Choice_Leaf_ScheduledPledgeGrant AND Scheduled_pk_EqualInstallments=Yes (see Decide_GCS_Insert). GC.ScheduleType back-fills from this GCS on the platform side after insert. Connector routes to Process_Scheduled_Commitment to synchronously activate the schedule, populate CurrentGiftCmtScheduleId + NextTransaction fields, and fan out the first Expected GT — without this, the record would wait for the once-daily FQS_Coordinate_Gift_Commitment_Processing batch at 01:00 UTC. Fault shares Error_RecordNotSaved.
recordCreates.name: Create_GCS_Scheduled
recordCreates.label: Create GCS — Scheduled (parent row)

recordCreates.description: Inserts the hand-authored Expected GT for a past-dated Simple pledge via inputReference on rsv_GT_SimplePastDate. Runs only when Pledge_dt_ExpectedEnd < TODAY (see Decide_GT_Simple_PastDate_Needs_GT). Compensates for the platform's refusal to fan out Expected GTs for past-dated schedule windows. Parents to the just-created GC and its GCS (rsv_GCS.Id was set by Create_GCS_Simple's inputReference). Connector routes to Get_GT_PastDue to rejoin the schedule-leaf terminal chain; fault shares Error_RecordNotSaved.
recordCreates.name: Create_GT_SimplePastDate
recordCreates.label: Create GT — Simple Past-Date Expected

recordCreates.description: Inserts the single-installment (N=1) Yearly GiftCommitmentSchedule row for a Simple Pledge / Grant via inputReference on rsv_GCS. Runs only when Intro_pk_LeafFuture=Choice_Leaf_SimplePledgeGrant (see Decide_GCS_Insert_Simple). GC.ScheduleType platform-back-fills to Recurring from this GCS after insert. Connector routes to Process_Simple_Commitment to synchronously activate the schedule + fan out the Expected GT — without this the record waits for the daily batch. Fault shares Error_RecordNotSaved.
recordCreates.name: Create_GCS_Simple
recordCreates.label: Create GCS — Simple (N=1 Yearly)

recordCreates.description: Bulk-inserts col_GTD_Split — the N GTDs (one per split GDD) built by Loop_GDD_ResolverCampaign_FanoutGTD or Loop_GDD_ResolverGC_FanoutGTD on the just-created GT. Reached from either loop's noMoreValuesConnector. Connector routes to Decide_GSC_Create — the same target Decide_GTD_Create's default connector uses, so the terminal chain after GTD creation is unchanged. Fault shares Error_RecordNotSaved.
recordCreates.name: Create_GTD_Split
recordCreates.label: Create GTDs — Split (collection)

recordLookups.description: Loads the donor Account by Id=recordId with getFirstRecordOnly + storeOutputAutomatically. Name is used on downstream screens for context text; DonorId comes straight from recordId at commit time; IsPersonAccount drives GiftType auto-derivation; PersonContactId feeds the Employer Match subflow inputs. Connector routes to Get_Contacts_ForAcct; fault routes to Error_CouldNotLoadData.
recordLookups.name: Get_Acct
recordLookups.label: Get Account

recordLookups.description: Loads all Contacts where AccountId=recordId with storeOutputAutomatically (getFirstRecordOnly=false). Their Ids feed the CampaignMember lookup and the ACR / CCR walks used to build the soft-credit reach list. Connector routes to Transform_Contacts_Ids; fault routes to Error_CouldNotLoadData.
recordLookups.name: Get_Contacts_ForAcct
recordLookups.label: Get Contacts — For Account

recordLookups.description: Loads active GiftCommitments for this donor for the Pledge Payment picker — DonorId=recordId AND (Status IN Active, Failing, Lapsed, Paused) AND FQS_Gift_Commitment_Category__c='Pledged Gift'. Category filter excludes Recurring Gift commitments because recurring payments materialize on schedule via the platform engine or gateway; hand-recording an off-cycle payment against a recurring stream is a distinct use case that routes through Outright Gift, not Pledge Payment. storeOutputAutomatically, all rows. Connector routes to Decide_GC_Show_Picker; fault routes to Error_CouldNotLoadData.
recordLookups.name: Get_GC_Active
recordLookups.label: Get GCs — Active

recordLookups.description: Loads the parent Campaign of the selected commitment (filter Id=rsv_GC_Selected.CampaignId, getFirstRecordOnly, storeOutputAutomatically) so Screen_Campaign_From_Commitment can display Campaign.Name in the read-only inherited-Campaign summary. Returns 0 rows if the commitment isn't attached to a Campaign — Screen_Campaign_From_Commitment's visibility rules handle the null branch with an advisory message. Read is safe because rsv_GC_Selected is loaded with storeOutputAutomatically=true by both GC-picker paths, so .CampaignId is a known-populated field even when null (per [[flow-unread-sobject-field-throws]]). Connector routes to Pick_CampaignFromCommitment; fault routes to Error_CouldNotLoadData.
recordLookups.name: Get_Camp_ForGC
recordLookups.label: Get Campaign — For GC

recordLookups.description: Loads all CampaignMembers whose ContactId IN Transform_Contacts_Ids (this Account's household). Feeds the Account-member Campaign filter used by Get_Camp_ForAcctMemberships. storeOutputAutomatically, all rows. Connector routes to Transform_CampaignMember_CampaignIds; fault routes to Error_CouldNotLoadData.
recordLookups.name: Get_CampaignMember_ForAcct
recordLookups.label: Get CampaignMember — For Account

recordLookups.description: Loads the picked commitment's GiftCommitmentSchedule (filter GiftCommitmentId=rsv_GC_Selected.Id, getFirstRecordOnly, storeOutputAutomatically). Used only to prefill Amount from TransactionAmount on the Pledge Payment / Recurring detail screens. Connector routes to Get_GT_ExistingOpen; fault routes to Error_CouldNotLoadData.
recordLookups.name: Get_GCS_ForGC
recordLookups.label: Get GCS — Current for GC

recordLookups.description: Loads the GiftCommitment identified by the contextCommitmentId input directly into rsv_GC_Selected via outputReference (NOT storeOutputAutomatically). This pre-populates the same SObject variable that the Account-entry path fills via Screen_Pick_Commitment / Assign_GC_From_Lookup so every downstream read of rsv_GC_Selected.Id / .CampaignId / .FulfillmentType / .FQS_Match_Eligible__c resolves correctly on the GC-entry path with a single load. Uses outputReference + queriedFields deliberately: SObject-to-SObject copy via an Assignment produces a reference whose downstream field reads return null (per [[flow-sobject-assign-drops-fields]]); outputReference bypasses that by writing the loaded record into the pre-declared variable directly. queriedFields must stay in sync with the fields the monolith reads off rsv_GC_Selected. Reached only from Decide_Screen_Entry_Mode's GC-context branch; connector routes to Assign_GC_Context_Entry; fault routes to Error_CouldNotLoadData.
recordLookups.name: Get_GC_Context
recordLookups.label: Get GC — Context (recordId)

recordLookups.description: Pre-fanout guard. Queries an existing GSC on rsv_GT.Id (getFirstRecordOnly, storeOutputAutomatically). The platform's schedule engine fans out GDSC → GSC when it materializes Expected GTs, so scheduled-payment GTs already have GSCs by the time PP Update runs; re-inserting would trip the hidden unique(GiftTransactionId, RecipientId) key ([[giftsoftcredit-unique-gt-recipient]]). Decide_GSC_Existing_On_GT reads this result: rows found → skip fanout; zero rows → proceed to Get_GDSC_ForGC. Recurring first-payment and PP Fresh Insert typically return zero rows here. Connector routes to Decide_GSC_Existing_On_GT; fault routes to Error_CouldNotLoadData.
recordLookups.name: Get_GSC_ExistingOnGT
recordLookups.label: Get GSC — Existing on GT

recordLookups.description: Loads open Expected GTs already fanned out on the picked commitment — GiftCommitmentId=rsv_GC_Selected.Id AND Status IN (Unpaid, Pending, Failed), ordered by TransactionDueDate ASC, storeOutputAutomatically. Feeds Screen_Existing_GTs's datatable so the user can post an existing scheduled payment rather than double-inserting a fresh one. Zero-row case (Simple Pledge, fully-posted schedule) routes past the datatable and falls through to the fresh-insert path via Decide_GT_Has_Existing_Open. Connector routes to Decide_GT_Has_Existing_Open; fault routes to Error_CouldNotLoadData.
recordLookups.name: Get_GT_ExistingOpen
recordLookups.label: Get GTs — Existing Open

recordLookups.description: After Process_Scheduled_Commitment / Process_Recurring_Commitment activates the just-created GC, loads whichever GiftDefaultDesignation the platform auto-inserted on rsv_GC.Id (getFirstRecordOnly, storeOutputAutomatically). If a row returns, Decide_GC_GDD_Post_Process compares its GiftDesignationId to var_GD_ResolvedId and either routes to Update_GDD_FromResolver (Override changed the pick) or skips. If no row returns (e.g., Recurring where the Campaign has no GDD to seed from), the flow falls through to Assign_GDD_Base → Create_GDD to insert one. Connector routes to Decide_GC_GDD_Post_Process; fault routes to Error_CouldNotLoadData.
recordLookups.name: Get_GDD_ForGC
recordLookups.label: Get GDD — For GC (post-process)

recordLookups.description: Loads all GDSCs on the parent GC where ParentRecordId=var_GC_GDSC_FanoutParentId (stamped by Assign_GDSC_Fanout_ParentId_FromGC_Picked on PP or Assign_GDSC_Fanout_ParentId_FromGC_New on Recurring first-payment). storeOutputAutomatically, all rows. Rows → Loop_GDSC_FanoutToGSC iterates them; zero rows → loop drains immediately → Create_GSC_FromGDSCs inserts an empty col_GSC_FromGDSCs (no-op). Connector routes to Loop_GDSC_FanoutToGSC; fault routes to Error_CouldNotLoadData.
recordLookups.name: Get_GDSC_ForGC
recordLookups.label: Get GDSCs — For GC

recordLookups.description: Pre-check for the manual soft-credit chain. Queries GiftSoftCredit by the exact tuple GiftTransactionId=rsv_GT.Id AND RecipientId=rsv_Acct_SelectedSoftCredit.Id (getFirstRecordOnly, storeOutputAutomatically, assignNullValuesIfNoRecordsFound=true). If the Employer Match subflow already inserted a 'Matched Donor' GSC for this donor GT + this recipient (user picked employer as manual soft-credit recipient), Create_GSC would fail with DUPLICATE_VALUE — the platform enforces a hidden unique(GiftTransactionId, RecipientId) constraint (see [[giftsoftcredit-unique-gt-recipient]]). Decide_GSC_Manual_AlreadyExists then skips the Create if found. Connector routes to Decide_GSC_Manual_AlreadyExists; fault routes to Error_RecordNotSaved.
recordLookups.name: Get_GSC_ExistingOnDonorGT_ForRecipient
recordLookups.label: Get GSC — Existing on Donor GT for Recipient

recordLookups.description: Loads the full GiftCommitment record from the lookup Id (filter Id=PickGC_lkp.recordId, getFirstRecordOnly, storeOutputAutomatically) so downstream logic has FulfillmentType and every other field needed off rsv_GC_Selected. Connector routes to Assign_GC_From_Lookup; fault routes to Error_CouldNotLoadData.
recordLookups.name: Get_GC_Lookup
recordLookups.label: Get GC — Looked-Up

recordLookups.description: Loads active Campaigns for which any Contact on this Account is a CampaignMember (filter Id IN Transform_CampaignMember_CampaignIds AND IsActive=true, storeOutputAutomatically, all rows). Empty collection is fine — the picker screen shows only the lookup escape hatch in that case. The member-campaign chain (Get_CampaignMember_ForAcct → Transform_CampaignMember_CampaignIds → Get_Camp_ForAcctMemberships) fires AFTER Screen_Category rather than before, so pre-first-screen work is limited to Get_Acct + Get_Contacts_ForAcct + one Transform. Two entry points converge on Get_CampaignMember_ForAcct: Assign_Preselect_ScreenAuto_To_Effectives (normal Home / Account path — user just picked category on Screen_Category) and Decide_Screen_Skip_Category_HasPreselect (Opportunity Setup Commitment preselect path — bypasses Screen_Category but still needs member campaigns for the downstream picker). GC-context path uses Get_Camp_ForGC (inherits from commitment) and does not traverse this chain. Connector routes to Decide_Screen_Category so both entry paths land at the leaf router with member campaigns loaded.
recordLookups.name: Get_Camp_ForAcctMemberships
recordLookups.label: Get Campaigns — Account Memberships

recordLookups.description: Loads every GiftTransaction on the just-created GC where GiftCommitmentId=rsv_GC.Id AND Status NotEqualTo 'Paid' AND TransactionDate <= $Flow.CurrentDate, ordered by TransactionDate ASC (storeOutputAutomatically, all rows). NotEqualTo 'Paid' is broader than Status='Unpaid' because the platform's default status for pre-activation fanned-out Expected GTs is 'Expected' (a Standard picklist value distinct from Unpaid) — the negation captures Expected + Unpaid + Pending + Failed, i.e., every unreconciled row (see [[gt-expected-status-default]]). Feeds Screen_Confirm_Past_Payments's datatable so the user can flag which past-dated payments have actually been received. Zero-row case (all future-dated fanout) routes past the screen via Decide_GT_Any_PastDue and rejoins the terminal chain at Decide_GDD_Create. Connector routes to Decide_GT_Any_PastDue; fault routes to Error_CouldNotLoadData.
recordLookups.name: Get_GT_PastDue
recordLookups.label: Get GTs — Past-Due Expected

recordUpdates.description: Bulk-updates col_GT_ConfirmedPaid — the GiftTransactions the user confirmed as received on Screen_Confirm_Past_Payments, built row-by-row by Loop_GT_ConfirmPaid with Id + Status=Paid stamped. Empty-collection case (user unchecked everything) is a no-op. Connector routes to Decide_GDD_Create. Fault shares Error_RecordNotSaved — a failed Update leaves the GC + schedule + Expected GTs intact in the org and the user can reconcile manually via GT list views.
recordUpdates.name: Update_GT_ConfirmedPaid
recordUpdates.label: Update GT — Confirmed Paid

recordUpdates.description: Updates the platform-auto GiftDefaultDesignation on the just-created Scheduled / Recurring GC to point at var_GD_ResolvedId, so an Override pick actually lands on the GC's default designation instead of the platform's Campaign-cascade choice. inputReference points at Get_GDD_ForGC (the row loaded post-activation); Assign_GC_GDD_Update_Fields stamped GiftDesignationId before this Update. Reached from Decide_GC_GDD_Post_Process when the loaded GDD's designation doesn't match the resolver's pick. Connector routes to Decide_Screen_Recurring_First_Payment_Or_Success. Fault shares Error_RecordNotSaved — a failed Update leaves the GC + GDD in the platform-default state, a graceful degradation of the Override rather than a hard failure.
recordUpdates.name: Update_GDD_FromResolver
recordUpdates.label: Update GDD — From Resolver Pick

recordUpdates.description: Posts an existing Expected GiftTransaction as Paid via inputReference on rsv_GT. Runs on the Update branch of Pledge Payment (UseExistingSched_pk_Mode=Update AND rsv_GT_Selected.Id set). Assign_GT_Update_Existing stamps rsv_GT.Id with rsv_GT_Selected.Id, so this recordUpdates targets the selected row rather than inserting. Connector routes to Decide_Match_Update_Path — when no match is opted-in (SinglePayment_pk_NeedsMatch=No) that decision defaults straight to Screen_Success because the platform engine already fanned out GiftDefaultDesignation / GTDesignation when it materialized the Expected GT, so designation / soft-credit fan-out is NOT re-run on this path. Fault shares Error_RecordNotSaved.
recordUpdates.name: Update_GT
recordUpdates.label: Update GT

screens.description: Past-payments confirmation branch. Reached when Get_GT_PastDue returned >=1 row (Decide_GT_Any_PastDue). Renders past-dated Expected GiftTransactions as a multi-select flowruntime:datatable; user checks rows whose money has already been received. Downstream Loop_GT_ConfirmPaid marks each selected row as Paid; unchecked rows stay Expected/Unpaid and surface in overdue reports for later reconciliation.
screens.name: Confirm_PastPayments
screens.label: Confirm - Past Payments Received

fields.name: PastPayments_Help
fields.fieldText:
Confirm which past payments have been received.


This commitment's schedule includes payments dated on or before today. Check the box next to each one that has actually been received — those will be marked Paid with a processed date of today. Leave a row unchecked to keep it as an outstanding Unpaid expected payment that can be reconciled later.

screens.description: Confirmation summary interstitial on the Pledge Payment Update branch, shown when the entered amount matches the scheduled OriginalAmount. Reached from Decide_GT_Amount_Mismatch's default connector; skipped on the mismatch path because Warning_AmountMismatch already summarizes amount + delta and a second interstitial would be redundant. Single Next -> Assign_GT_Update_Existing -> Update_GT.
screens.name: Confirm_PledgePaymentUpdate
screens.label: Confirm - Pledge Payment

fields.name: PledgePaymentUpdate_Header
fields.fieldText: Ready to post this payment?

fields.name: PledgePaymentUpdate_Help_Body
fields.fieldText:
Posting {!formulaDisplay_NumGiftAmount} on the scheduled payment due {!formulaDisplay_TransactionDueDate} as {!formulaDisplay_PaymentMethod}.


Click Next to record the payment, or Previous to adjust the details.

screens.description: Pledge Payment leaf, gated on Get_GT_ExistingOpen returning >=1 row (Decide_GT_Has_Existing_Open). Renders the picked commitment's open Expected GTs (Unpaid/Pending/Failed, oldest first) as a single-select datatable and asks whether to post against an existing scheduled payment or record a fresh one-off. Selected row lands in rsv_GT_Selected via firstSelectedRow; mode captured in UseExistingSched_pk_Mode and consumed downstream by Decide_GCS_Prefill_Amount and Decide_GT_Amount_Mismatch. The datatable is visibility-gated to the Update choice so the New-payment mode hides it.
screens.name: Confirm_UseExistingScheduledPayment
screens.label: Confirm - Post Existing Scheduled Payment

fields.name: UseExistingSched_Help
fields.fieldText:
This commitment has scheduled payments that haven't been posted yet.


Pick the scheduled payment this donation applies to (usually the oldest unpaid row), or record a brand-new one-off payment that leaves the schedule untouched.

fields.name: UseExistingSched_pk_Mode
fields.fieldText: How should we record this payment?
fields.helpText: Post = you're recording a payment against a scheduled row that has already been generated for you. New = you're logging an extra one-off payment that leaves the schedule rows untouched.

screens.description: Simple Pledge / Grant leaf. Collects subcategory (Pledged Gift vs Grant Payout), expected total amount, effective start date, expected single-payment date, formal-commitment type, payment method, soft-credit toggle, and match-eligible flag (Person Account only via visibilityRule on Get_Acct.IsPersonAccount). Question-style labels name the underlying FundFirst field in parens. Downstream Assign_GC_Pledge_Defaults + Assign_GCS_Simple_Row insert a GC plus a single-installment Yearly GCS (N=1) so the platform derives NextTransactionDate, NextTransactionAmount, and CurrentGiftCmtScheduleId -- see [[pledge-requires-gcs]].
screens.name: Details_Pledge
screens.label: Details - Pledge

fields.name: Pledge_Help
fields.fieldText:
Pledge / Grant Details


Creating a Single Payment Pledge / Grant commitment for {!Get_Acct.Name} — full amount, single future payment.

fields.name: Pledge_num_Amount
fields.fieldText: How much is the donor committing? (Expected Total Commitment Amount)
fields.helpText: Total amount the donor is committing across all future payments. Reports on projected income roll up from this field.

fields.name: Pledge_dt_EffectiveStart
fields.fieldText: When was the grant awarded / the pledge made? (Effective Start Date)
fields.helpText: The date the commitment as a whole becomes active — an audit / reporting anchor on the parent Gift Commitment. Distinct from the expected payment date below. Must be today or in the past — a pledge or grant can't be awarded in the future.

validationRule.errorMessage: Effective Start Date must be today or in the past — a pledge or grant can't be awarded in the future. If the donor hasn't committed yet, don't record a commitment.

fields.name: Pledge_dt_ExpectedEnd
fields.fieldText: When is this single payment expected? (Expected End Date)
fields.helpText: The date the single expected payment is due. The launcher builds a Gift Commitment Schedule row anchored to this date; the platform then fans out one Expected Gift Transaction on this date and sets Next Transaction Date on the commitment to match. Also written to Expected End Date on the commitment. Must be on or after the Effective Start Date. If the date is in the past, the schedule activates immediately and the Expected GT lands as overdue (Unpaid) — record the payment via the Pledge Payment leaf when it arrives.

validationRule.errorMessage: Expected payment date must be on or after the Effective Start Date — a payment can't be due before the pledge was made.

fields.name: Pledge_preview_Schedule
fields.fieldText:
Schedule preview

{!formulaSimplePreviewText}

fields.name: Pledge_pk_PaymentMethod
fields.fieldText: How will the donor pay? (Payment Method)
fields.helpText: Applied to the single Gift Commitment Schedule row generated by this commitment, which in turn defaults the Expected Gift Transaction that fans out. If the payment method changes when the money arrives, edit the Gift Transaction directly.

fields.name: Pledge_sec_AdditionalDetails
fields.fieldText: Additional Details

fields.name: Pledge_pk_Subcategory
fields.fieldText: What kind of commitment is this? (Gift Commitment Category)
fields.helpText: Sets the FQS Gift Commitment Category on the new commitment. Pledged Gift is typical for individual donors; Grant Payout is typical for foundation or corporate giving programs.

fields.name: Pledge_pk_FormalType
fields.fieldText: How was the commitment made? (Formal Commitment Type)
fields.helpText: Written = signed pledge card, grant agreement, or comparable paper trail. Verbal = pledge made in conversation with no signed document. Used for auditor / compliance reporting.

fields.name: Pledge_pk_NeedsSoftCredits
fields.fieldText: Add a default soft credit for this commitment?
fields.helpText: A default soft credit on the commitment recognizes a related account (spouse, solicitor, influencer, etc.) on every future payment automatically. Choose Yes to pick a recipient and role after the commitment is created.

fields.name: Pledge_pk_MatchEligible
fields.fieldText: Is this donor employed at a match-program organization? (Match Eligible)
fields.helpText: Flag this commitment so payment posts will default the employer-match prompt to Yes. Written to Match Eligible on the Gift Commitment record.

screens.description: Recurring Gift leaf. Collects amount per payment, cadence (Weekly / Monthly / Yearly + interval), first payment date, payment method, soft-credit toggle, and match-eligible flag; open-ended by contract -- no ExpectedTotalCmtAmount, no EndDate. Category is hard-set to Recurring Gift with no subcategory picker (Recurring is neither a pledge nor a grant). An integration disclaimer sits above the inputs to steer users toward the donation-form integration for the normal case; the launcher exists for one-off admin capture. Bindings feed rsv_GC via Assign_GC_Recurring_Defaults.
screens.name: Details_Recurring
screens.label: Details - Recurring Gift

fields.name: Recurring_Help
fields.fieldText:
Recurring Gift Details


Creating an open-ended Recurring Gift commitment for {!Get_Acct.Name} — a repeating gift stream that continues until the donor cancels.

fields.name: Recurring_Help_Disclaimer
fields.fieldText: ⚠ Integration disclaimer Most recurring gifts will be created through an integration with your donation form tool. This option is included in case you ever need to enter a gift from a non-integrated tool for any reason. If your donation form tool has stopped working, contact your Salesforce administrator or your donation form tool's support team to resolve the issue before entering data here. Manual entry while an integration is broken risks duplicate recurring commitments once the integration is restored.

fields.name: Recurring_sec_Gift
fields.fieldText: Gift Key Details

fields.name: Recurring_num_Amount
fields.fieldText: How much per payment? (Transaction Amount)
fields.helpText: The amount the donor will give on each recurring payment. Stamped on every Expected Gift Transaction the schedule engine fans out.

fields.name: Recurring_pk_PaymentMethod
fields.fieldText: How will the donor pay? (Payment Method — applied to every payment)
fields.helpText: Applied to every Expected Gift Transaction the recurring schedule generates. Most recurring gifts run on Credit Card or ACH; a manual entry here is unusual outside a broken integration scenario.

fields.name: Recurring_sec_Schedule
fields.fieldText: Schedule Details

fields.name: Recurring_Help_Schedule
fields.fieldText: Set the cadence of the recurring gifts by selecting the interval and the period below. The default is set to every third (interval) month (period) to represent a quarterly recurrence.

fields.name: Recurring_num_Interval
fields.fieldText: Every how many periods? (Transaction Interval)
fields.helpText: Multiplier on the Period below. 1 = every period, 2 = every other period, etc.

fields.name: Recurring_pk_Period
fields.fieldText: How often will the donor pay? (Transaction Period)
fields.helpText: Weekly / Monthly / Yearly. Combine with the Interval field above to express custom cadences — e.g., Monthly + Interval 2 = every 2 months, Monthly + Interval 3 = every 3 months (Quarterly), Monthly + Interval 6 = twice a year. FundFirst does not carry a native Quarterly value; use Monthly + 3 to express it.

fields.name: Recurring_dt_Start
fields.fieldText: When did the first payment happen? (Start Date)
fields.helpText: Date of the first recurring payment. Must be today or in the past — recurring gifts are retroactive: the donor is already giving, and you are recording that they are. If the first payment has not happened yet, record a Pledge instead (Simple or Scheduled). The engine anchors the cadence from this date and continues fanning out Expected Gift Transactions indefinitely. Also used as the commitment's Effective Start Date.

validationRule.errorMessage: Recurring gifts must start today or in the past — the donor is already giving. If the first payment has not happened yet, go back and choose Pledge (Simple or Scheduled) instead.

fields.name: Recurring_preview_Schedule
fields.fieldText:
Schedule preview

{!formulaRecurringPreviewText}

fields.name: Recurring_sec_AdditionalDetails
fields.fieldText: Gift Additional Details

fields.name: Recurring_pk_MatchEligible
fields.fieldText: Is this donor employed at a match-program organization? (Match Eligible)
fields.helpText: Flag this commitment so payment posts will default the employer-match prompt to Yes. Written to Match Eligible on the Gift Commitment record.

Purposeful launchers should also set the output rsv_GC on the subflow call so their own Screen_Success can link to the created GC.
variables.name: hideSuccessScreen

variables.description: Optional input from a purposeful launcher (e.g. Opportunity Setup Commitment) that pre-answers the Category radio. Values: "Monetary" | "Future" | "Special" — same set as Choice_Cat_*.value. When set, Decide_Preselect_Route bypasses Screen_Category and Assign_Preselect_Effectives seeds varCategoryEffective + varLeafFutureEffective directly. When blank (Home / Account / GC surfaces), Decide_Preselect_Route falls through to Get_Acct and Screen_Category runs; Assign_Preselect_ScreenAuto_To_Effectives then mirrors the user's picks into the effectives after the screen ([[monolith-preselect-effective-var-pattern]]).
variables.name: preselectCategory

variables.description: Optional input paired with preselectCategory. For Category="Future": pass Choice_Leaf_SimplePledgeGrant.value ("Simple") or Choice_Leaf_ScheduledPledgeGrant.value ("Scheduled"). For Category="Monetary"/"Special": unused (screen still runs). When set, Assign_Preselect_Effectives writes this into varLeafFutureEffective so every downstream reader (Decide_Screen_Leaf_Future, Decide_GCS_Insert, Decide_GTD_After_Pledge, Decide_Override_Needs_Restriction_IsCommitmentCreation, Decide_GDD_Create_ScheduleLeaf, Success_LinkGC visibilityRule) sees the preselected value.
variables.name: preselectLeaf

variables.description: Input: Id of the Account from which the flow is launched. Passed automatically by the Lightning quick action.
variables.name: recordId

variables.description: Per-iteration variable for Loop_GT_ConfirmPaid — assignNextValueToReference target. Body Assign_GT_Confirm_Paid_Row mutates this row's Status before appending to col_GT_ConfirmedPaid.
variables.name: rsv_GT_ConfirmedLoopItem

variables.description: Record variable staged per iteration of Loop_GCS_CustomBuildFromRepeater — receives per-row Date/Amount from Scheduled_rep_CustomInstallments.AllItems plus shared PaymentMethod/GiftCommitmentId. Appended to col_GCS_Custom.
variables.name: rsv_GCS_Custom

variables.description: Per-iteration cursor for Loop_GT_CustomBuild on the second pass. After Create_GCS_Custom inserts N GCSs, Loop_GT_CustomBuild iterates col_GCS_Custom (which now has Ids stamped) so each hand-authored past-date compensating GT can parent to a specific GCS Id via GiftCommitmentScheduleId.
variables.name: rsv_GCS_CustomLoopItem

variables.description: Record variable staged per iteration of Loop_GT_CustomBuild — receives per-row Date/Amount from Scheduled_rep_CustomInstallments.AllItems plus shared PaymentMethod/GiftCommitmentId. Appended to col_GT_Custom.
variables.name: rsv_GT_Custom

variables.description: Template GCS row appended to col_GCS_TemplateRows so the Scheduled_rep_CustomInstallments on Screen_Scheduled_Details renders visible fields for the first entry. Not itself inserted — user Add-Item / edits live on Repeater.AllItems ([[flow-repeater-output-quirk]]), which Loop_GCS_CustomBuildFromRepeater / Loop_GT_CustomBuild then read to build the actual rows.
variables.name: rsv_GCS_TemplateRow

variables.description: Loop iteration variable for Loop_GDSC_FanoutToGSC. Exposes the current GDSC (RecipientId, Role, PartialPercent) to Assign_GSC_From_GDSC.
variables.name: rsv_GDSC_LoopItem

variables.description: Record variable bound to Screen_Pledge_Details. Staged by the GC-shaping assignments (Assign_GC_Pledge_Defaults, Assign_GC_Scheduled_Defaults, Assign_GC_Recurring_Defaults, Assign_GC_Grant_Defaults) and inserted by Create_GC_Pledge via inputReference. Exposed as an output so purposeful launcher parents (Opportunity Setup Commitment) can link to the created GC on their own Success screen.
variables.name: rsv_GC

variables.description: Record variable for the GiftCommitmentSchedule row inserted on the Scheduled Pledge/Grant leaf (Regular). Populated by Assign_GCS_Scheduled_Row; inserted via Create_GCS_Scheduled's inputReference.
variables.name: rsv_GCS

variables.description: Record variable staged by Assign_GDD_Base and inserted by Create_GDD on GC-creating leaves. ParentRecordId is the parent GC.Id ([[gdd-parent-polymorphic]] restricts this to Campaign / GC / Opportunity); AllocatedPercentage=100 for the single-GDD case.
variables.name: rsv_GDD

variables.description: Record variable staged by Assign_GDSC_Base and inserted by Create_GDSC. Represents the commitment-level default soft credit (ParentRecordId = rsv_GC.Id) that the platform propagates to every current + future GT under this commitment via the schedule engine's fanout. Written only on the GC-creating leaves (Simple, Pledge, Recurring, Grant) when SinglePayment_pk_NeedsSoftCredits=Yes; distinct from rsv_GSC which handles GT-level GSCs on Outright / Pledge Payment.
variables.name: rsv_GDSC

variables.description: Record variable for the GT-level GiftSoftCredit created after a GiftTransaction insert on Outright / Pledge Payment when a soft-credit recipient was chosen. Distinct from rsv_GDSC (commitment-level) and rsv_GSC_InKindSelf (auto in-kind self-recognition).
variables.name: rsv_GSC

variables.description: Record variable bound to Screen_Gift_Details via ObjectProvided fields. All GiftTransaction inserts use this via inputReference.
variables.name: rsv_GT

variables.description: Scratch GiftSoftCredit record built each iteration of Loop_GDSC_FanoutToGSC. Assign_GSC_From_GDSC populates its fields and appends to col_GSC_FromGDSCs.
variables.name: rsv_GSC_FromGDSC

variables.description: Record variable staged by Assign_GTD_Base and inserted by Create_GiftTransactionDesignation after a GiftTransaction insert.
variables.name: rsv_GTD

variables.description: Record variable for the auto-generated self-recognition GiftSoftCredit created on In-Kind gifts (Role='In-Kind Recognition', RecipientId = the donor Account). Distinct from rsv_GSC so the manual third-party soft-credit path and the automatic in-kind self-credit path don't collide when both fire on the same gift ([[fqs-inkind-flag-load-bearing]]; [[giftsoftcredit-unique-gt-recipient]] requires the two carry different RecipientIds).
variables.name: rsv_GSC_InKindSelf

variables.description: Campaign picked on Screen_Pick_Campaign — datatable firstSelectedRow or flowruntime:lookup escape. Read downstream by Assign_GTD_Base / Assign_GDD_Base for CampaignId and by the resolver-input assignments.
variables.name: rsv_Camp_Selected

variables.description: GiftCommitment picked on Screen_Pick_Commitment for the Pledge Payment leaf (datatable firstSelectedRow or flowruntime:lookup escape). Also pre-populated by Assign_GC_Context_Entry on the GC-context entry path (contextCommitmentId set).
variables.name: rsv_GC_Selected

variables.description: GiftDesignation picked on Screen_Pick_Designation (datatable firstSelectedRow or flowruntime:lookup escape). Also written in parallel by every Assign_Resolve_Designation_* terminal so downstream Assign_GTD_Base / Assign_GDD_Base can keep reading .Id unchanged.
variables.name: rsv_GD_Selected

variables.description: Account picked from the reach datatable on Screen_Pick_SoftCredit_Commitment (commitment-level default soft-credit recipient). Distinct from rsv_Acct_SelectedSoftCredit (GT-level picker) so the two branches don't collide when both fire in the same flow run.
variables.name: rsv_Acct_SelectedGDSC

variables.description: The open Expected GiftTransaction the user picked on Screen_Existing_GTs to post as this payment. Populated by UseExistingSched_tbl_Existing.firstSelectedRow. Consumed by Update_GT (only when UseExistingSched_pk_Mode='Update'). Left null on the fresh-insert branch.
variables.name: rsv_GT_Selected

variables.description: Account picked on Screen_Pick_SoftCredit (GT-level soft-credit recipient) — datatable firstSelectedRow or flowruntime:lookup escape. Consumed by Assign_GSC_Base.
variables.name: rsv_Acct_SelectedSoftCredit

variables.description: Record variable for the hand-authored Expected GT on the Simple leaf past-date branch (Assign_GT_Simple_PastDate stages, Create_GT_SimplePastDate inserts). Compensates for the platform not fanning out Expected GTs when the schedule window is entirely in the past. Deliberately distinct from rsv_GT (reserved for the shared match / first-payment chain) to avoid variable coupling.
variables.name: rsv_GT_SimplePastDate

variables.description: Loop iteration variable for Loop_GDD_ResolverCampaign_FanoutGTD / _GC. Exposes the current GDD (GiftDesignationId, AllocatedPercentage) to Assign_Build_Split_GTD.
variables.name: rsv_GDD_SplitLoopItem

variables.description: Scratch GiftTransactionDesignation record built each iteration of Loop_GDD_ResolverCampaign_FanoutGTD / _GC. Assign_Build_Split_GTD populates its fields and appends to col_GTD_Split.
variables.name: rsv_GTD_SplitScratch

variables.description: Sub-picker for the Future Commitment category on Screen_Pledge_Details, used by Simple / Scheduled Pledge/Grant leaves to route the created GiftCommitment's FQS_Gift_Commitment_Category__c. Values: "Pledged Gift" or "Grant Payout".
variables.name: var_GC_Subcategory

variables.description: Count of active GDDs on the picked GiftCommitment (Pledge Payment branch). Populated by Loop_Count_GC_GDDs on the PP branch only. Feeds Platform_Split detection so the resolver defers to the platform when the GC has >1 GDD.
variables.name: var_GC_GDDCount

variables.description: Parent GC Id used as the ParentRecordId filter on Get_GDSC_ForGC. Stamped by Assign_GDSC_Fanout_ParentId_FromGC_Picked (PP: rsv_GC_Selected.Id) or Assign_GDSC_Fanout_ParentId_FromGC_New (Recurring first-payment: rsv_GC.Id). Never read directly by anything else.
variables.name: var_GC_GDSC_FanoutParentId

variables.description: Normalized Account Id of the picked GDSC recipient. Written by Assign_GDSC_Recipient_FromTable (datatable path) or Assign_GDSC_Recipient_FromLookup (fallback lookup path); read by Assign_GDSC_Base.
variables.name: var_GDSC_RecipientId

variables.description: Single Amount input on Screen_Gift_Details. Assigned to rsv_GT.OriginalAmount in Assign_GT_Fanout_Amount. CurrentAmount is not written by the flow — the platform derives it from OriginalAmount on insert.
variables.name: var_GT_OriginalAmount

variables.description: Counter incremented inside Loop_GDSC_FanoutToGSC. Drives the Screen_Success summary line that tells the user how many default soft credits were propagated. Starts at 0; visibility of the summary line hinges on it being > 0.
variables.name: var_GSC_FanoutCount

variables.description: Set true when either the picked Campaign OR the picked GC has >1 GDD (a split default). The resolver's Tier 0 rule (Platform_Split) fires when this is true and routes to Assign_Resolve_Designation_PlatformSplit, which sets var_GD_ResolvedSource=Platform_Split and deliberately does NOT populate rsv_GD_Selected.Id — Decide_GTD_Create and Decide_GDD_Create guards then skip the flow's own GTD/GDD inserts so the platform's native multi-row default fanout is authoritative. Also drives Confirm-screen visibility (show a datatable of the split GDDs, hide the Override checkbox) and the post-Process reconciliation gate (Decide_GC_GDD_Post_Process skips Update-or-Insert entirely so the platform's split copy on the GC stays intact).
variables.name: var_GTD_PlatformSplitApplies

variables.description: Id of the GiftDesignation chosen by Resolve_Designation_Hierarchy. Set by one of the Assign_Resolve_Designation_* terminals. Read by the Campaign-screen summary line and downstream by Assign_GTD_Base / Assign_GDD_Base via rsv_GD_Selected.Id (which the same terminal writes in parallel).
variables.name: var_GD_ResolvedId

variables.description: Which tier of the resolver won. One of: Campaign_Default, Org_Default, User_Override, Existing_GTD, GC_Default, Platform_Split. Drives the Campaign-screen summary text and the Platform_Split branch's downstream skips.
variables.name: var_GD_ResolvedSource

variables.description: Screen-scoped restriction picklist value chosen on Screen_Pick_Restriction. Used only to filter the designation picker; not stored on GiftCommitment.
variables.name: var_GC_RestrictionType

variables.description: Effective category discriminator — canonical read for downstream decisions. Populated by either Assign_Preselect_Effectives (skip path, when preselectCategory is set) or Assign_Preselect_ScreenAuto_To_Effectives (normal path, mirrors Screen_Category's Intro_pk_Category auto-var after the user picks). Every downstream decision reads this so both entry paths converge on a single canonical value. NEW code must read varCategoryEffective, NEVER Intro_pk_Category directly ([[monolith-preselect-effective-var-pattern]]).
variables.name: varCategoryEffective

variables.description: Effective Future-leaf discriminator — canonical read for downstream decisions on the Future branch. Populated by either Assign_Preselect_Effectives (skip path, when preselectLeaf is set) or Assign_Preselect_ScreenAuto_To_Effectives (normal path, mirrors Screen_Category's Intro_pk_LeafFuture auto-var). NEW code must read varLeafFutureEffective, NEVER Intro_pk_LeafFuture directly ([[monolith-preselect-effective-var-pattern]]).
variables.name: varLeafFutureEffective

variables.description: Caller-side var mirroring Intro_pk_LeafMonetary screen auto-var — projected by Assign_Resolver_Inputs so the resolver subflow can receive it as an input (screen auto-vars aren't safely readable across subflow boundaries per [[flow-screen-autovar-subflow-input]]).
variables.name: var_ResolverInput_LeafMonetary

variables.description: Caller-side var mirroring Intro_pk_LeafSpecial screen auto-var — projected by Assign_Resolver_Inputs so the resolver subflow can receive it as an input ([[flow-screen-autovar-subflow-input]]).
variables.name: var_ResolverInput_LeafSpecial

variables.description: Caller-side var mirroring UseExistingSched_pk_Mode screen auto-var — projected by Assign_Resolver_Inputs so the resolver subflow can receive it as an input ([[flow-screen-autovar-subflow-input]]).
variables.name: var_ResolverInput_PledgePaymentMode

variables.description: Caller-side receiver for the resolver subflow's out_didError. Read by Decide_Resolver_DidError.
variables.name: var_ResolverOutput_DidError

variables.description: Caller-side receiver for the resolver subflow's out_errorMessage. Currently only staged; available if Error_CouldNotLoadData ever surfaces the message dynamically.
variables.name: var_ResolverOutput_ErrorMessage

variables.description: Caller-side receiver for the resolver subflow's out_resolvedPath. Values: "Accepted" / "MissingOrgDefault". Read by Decide_Resolver_Return_Router.
variables.name: var_ResolverOutput_ResolvedPath

variables.description: Caller-side receiver for the resolver subflow's out_selectedCampaignId. Read by Assign_Resolver_Selected_Campaign to stamp rsv_Camp_Selected.Id.
variables.name: var_ResolverOutput_SelectedCampaignId

variables.description: Caller-side receiver for the resolver subflow's out_campaignGDDs. Iterated by Loop_GDD_ResolverCampaign_FanoutGTD on the multi-GDD Campaign path (var_GTD_PlatformSplitApplies=true, var_CampaignGDDCount > 1).
variables.name: col_GDD_ResolverCampaign

variables.description: Caller-side receiver for the resolver subflow's out_gcGDDs. Iterated by Loop_GDD_ResolverGC_FanoutGTD on the multi-GDD Pledge Payment path.
variables.name: col_GDD_ResolverGC

variables.description: Caller-side receiver for out_didError from BOTH Subflow_Call_Match_Resolve and Subflow_Call_Match_CreateAndPair. Decide_Match_Subflow_Error reads this and routes to Error_CouldNotLoadData or Error_RecordNotSaved.
variables.name: var_MatchSubflow_DidError

variables.description: Caller-side receiver for the match subflow's out_errorMessage. Debug context only — not currently surfaced to end users.
variables.name: var_MatchSubflow_ErrorMessage

variables.description: Confirmed match amount. Written by Assign_Match_Stash_Resolve_Outputs from Subflow_Call_Match_Resolve.out_matchAmount. Re-passed to createAndPair via in_matchAmountFromCaller. Also read by Screen_Success.Success_Match.
variables.name: var_MatchAmount

variables.description: Match GT status choice. Values: "Pending" / "Paid". Written by Assign_Match_Stash_Resolve_Outputs from Subflow_Call_Match_Resolve.out_matchStatus. Re-passed to createAndPair via in_matchStatusFromCaller.
variables.name: var_MatchStatus

variables.description: Confirmed employer Account Id. Written by Assign_Match_Stash_Resolve_Outputs from Subflow_Call_Match_Resolve.out_matchEmployerId. Re-passed to createAndPair via in_matchEmployerIdFromCaller.
variables.name: var_MatchEmployerId

variables.description: Employer Account Name. Written by Assign_Match_Stash_Resolve_Outputs from Subflow_Call_Match_Resolve.out_matchEmployerName. Read by Screen_Success.Success_Match.
variables.name: var_MatchEmployerName

variables.description: Success flag gating Screen_Success.Success_Match visibility. Written by Subflow_Call_Match_CreateAndPair.out_matchApplied on createAndPair success — a subflow can't reach across the flow boundary to set screen auto-vars, so this caller-side var carries the signal.
variables.name: var_MatchApplied

variables.description: Caller-side scratch: donor gift amount (leaf-agnostic). Written by Assign_Match_Inputs_Resolve using BLANKVALUE(SinglePayment_num_Amount, Recurring_num_Amount). Passed to the resolve subflow as in_donorGiftAmount so formulaMatchAmountDefault and Assign_MatchSoftCredit_OnDonor.PartialAmount can read a real var (screen auto-vars unwritable across flow boundary per [[flow-screen-autovar-subflow-input]]).
variables.name: var_GT_DonorAmount
